Fresh encounter in J&K’s Kulgam as security forces track escaped LeT terrorist Lateef Bhat
 There was no exchange of fire since November 16; contact with the terrorists was established during the searches this morning, leading to a renewed firefight to neutralise the only surviving local terrorist in Kashmir valley
 Updated - November 18, 2026 08:13 am IST - Srinagar 
 PTI READ LATER 
 SEE ALL 
 Remove 
 File photo for representational purposes only.
 | Photo Credit: AP
 An encounter broke out between security forces and terrorists on Wednesday (November 18, 2026) in Jammu and Kashmir's Kulgam district, where a terrorist was killed in a gunfight two days ago , police said.
 “#Encounter started with terrorists and joint party of JKP and SF in Kulgam,” Kashmir Zone Police said in a post on X.
 On Monday (November 16, 2026), security forces killed Umar Nisar Dar, one of the terrorists involved in the November 11 attack on CRPF personnel in Kulgam.
 Kulgam anti-terror ops. continue; body of LeT terrorist Lateef Bhat’s ‘accomplice’ retrieved from encounter site Another terrorist, Lateef Bhat, one of the most wanted and the only surviving local terrorist in Kashmir valley, managed to escape the cordon at the Laru bypass area.
 While there was no exchange of gunfire since Monday (November 16, 2026), security forces continued a massive search operation in a vast area around the encounter site to track and neutralise Bhat.
 During the searches on early Wednesday (November 18, 2026) morning, contact with the terrorists was established, leading to a renewed firefight that is ongoing.
 J&K Police zero in on LeT operative, two foreigners in Kulgam CRPF attack According to officials, Dar allegedly provided shelter and logistical support for nearly six months to terrorist commander Bhat, and the duo conducted reconnaissance before executing the attack on a CRPF post on Wednesday last week, which left three personnel injured.
 Dar, a former breadmaker who had been reported missing by his family, was killed in an encounter with security forces on Monday (November 16, 2026), barely a week after he allegedly joined The Resistance Front (TRF), an offshoot of the LeT.
